title: CytoLex KB — shared definitions
description: Rule IDs, citations and vocabularies shared by rule and quote files. Conventions: kb/README.md.

version.description: ISCN edition year; must equal the version directory (kb/rules/<version>/).
version.x-expected: an edition year in quotes, e.g. "2016"

section.description: Numbered ISCN section, as in the chunk front matter (e.g. 9.2.17.1).
section.x-expected: a section number in quotes, e.g. "9.2.17.1"

rule_id.description: Stable concept ID: dot-separated UPPER_SNAKE segments, at least two, the first a topic prefix (e.g. TRANSLOC.CHROMOSOME_ORDER). Never renamed.
rule_id.x-expected: a valid rule ID (dot-separated UPPER_SNAKE segments, at least two, e.g. TRANSLOC.CHROMOSOME_ORDER)

cite.description: Book location. Rendered as 'ISCN <version> §<section>, p.<page>, ¶n' or '…, ¶n, ex. En' or '…, p.<page>, <float>'. Anchors are the chunk labels [¶n p.N], [En p.N], [Fig. N p.N]; page is the book page of that label.

example.x-expected: an example label (E + number, e.g. E3)

float.description: Figure/table label as printed in the chunk (Fig. 7, Fig. 6a, Table 1, Ploidy table, Alignment figure, Fibre diagram).
float.x-expected: a float label as printed in the chunk (Fig. 7, Fig. 6a, Table 1, Ploidy table)

applies_to.description: Notation types a rule applies to.

context.description: Clinical context a rule applies in.

severity.description: Default severity of a violation (policy refined in T-022).
